title: Replacing Just 10 Percent of Ultra‑processed Foods with Whole Foods Linked to Drop in Bowel Cancer Rate - Nautilus
author: Erikka Loftfield
text: Subscribe to skip adsAdvertisementHealthReplacing Just 10 Percent of Ultra‑processed Foods with Whole Foods Linked to Drop in Bowel Cancer RateExamples of ultra processed foods include many supermarket breads, cured meats and some breakfast cerealsELBy Erikka Loftfield7:00 AM CDT on October 17, 2026Add Nautilus to GoogleReplacing 10% of your intake of ultra-processed foods with minimally processed foods is linked with 2% lower incidence of bowel cancer, according to our new analysis of data from more than 460,000 U.S. adults.However, we also found no association between total ultra-processed food intake and bowel cancer incidence.That said, intake of wholegrains, fibre, dairy, and calcium from ultra-processed food sources was associated with lower bowel cancer incidence. Eating ultra-processed meats was associated with higher bowel cancer incidence.Subscribe to skip adsAdvertisement
